headline: Silver Prices Rally Strongly Following Recent Three-Month Decline
summary: Following sharp drops over the preceding three months, the silver market rebounded strongly on Friday, with prices rising over 8%.
why: Precious metal price volatility impacts mining company revenues and investor commodity allocations.

impacts.name: Silver
impacts.why: Silver spot prices experienced an upward correction of over 8% in market trading.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Bargain buying and market technical corrections following a three-month decline drove the sharp rebound in silver prices.
